trade_league_arsenal_01 = {
	type_icon = duchy_buildings/royal_armory.dds

	cost = { gold = trade_post_building_tier_1_cost_value }
	construction_time = trade_post_building_construction_time_value
	next_building = trade_league_arsenal_02

	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				exists = trade_post_district
			}
			trade_post_owner ?= {
				gdp_is_trade_league_member_trigger = yes
			}
		}
	
            }
        }
    }

	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				exists = trade_post_district
			}
			trade_post_owner ?= {
				gdp_league_can_build_arsenals_trigger = yes
			}
		}
	
            }
        }
    }

	is_enabled = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				exists = trade_post_district
			}
			trade_post_owner ?= {
				gdp_is_trade_league_member_trigger = yes
			}
		}
	
            }
        }
    }

	character_modifier = {
		knight_limit = 1
		knight_effectiveness_mult = 0.05
		levy_size = 0.01
	}
	county_modifier = {
		stationed_maa_damage_mult = 0.02
		stationed_maa_control_value_add = 1
	}
	province_modifier = {
	}
	market_modifier = {
	}

	flag = league_arsenal_flag

	ai_value = {
		base = 10.6
		ai_trade_post_general_building_modifier = yes
		ai_trade_post_directive_to_build_military_modifier = yes
		ai_trade_post_new_building_modifier = yes
	}
}
